scale.description: scale is the multiplicative factor 1, 1000, 1000000, or 1000000000, or null when unknown. It is NOT a base-10 exponent: never use 0, 3, 6, or 9 as scale values. Normalize a printed value by multiplying by scale; keep raw_value unchanged. Money and shares have separately source-supported factors; per_share scale is 1.
scale.title: Scale

currency.description: currency is an explicit uppercase ISO 4217 currency code such as USD, or null when unknown. For quantity shares currency MUST be null; never use Shares as a currency. For quantity per_share use the supported currency code such as USD and scale 1; never use USDperShare, USD/share, or USD per share as currency values.
currency.title: Currency
